entries.note: A label made through Paquetexpress's web services, before the parcel is handed over. The service appends the user who made it after "POR", which the adapter cuts.
A request for a pickup at the sender's address.
A pickup is planned; the driver has not collected the parcel yet.
The pickup request is cancelled. It moves nothing: the sender can still hand the parcel in.
The sender handed the parcel in at a branch's counter.
A driver collected the parcel. The service appends the sender after "A", which the adapter cuts.
The collected parcel is in the branch's warehouse.
Received at the destination branch. For a parcel the recipient collects there (delivery type ENT_OCU), it waits for pickup instead.
A transfer between trailers. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.
Planned for a delivery round, not yet on it. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.

entries.wording: En Ruta De Entrega A Domicilio

entries.note: Delivered at the door. The service appends ", recibió" and whoever took it, which the adapter cuts.
Collected by the recipient at the branch; the name after ", recibió" is cut.
Paid for in cash and handed over at the destination; the tracker shows it as delivered. The name after ", recibió" is cut.
